        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)

    def test_complaints_list(self):
        response = client.get("/complaints")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("Scope creep never ends.", response.text)

        response = client.post("/complaints", data={"agent_name": "Agent_999", "text": "The human is being difficult."}, follow_redirects=False)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 303)
        self.assertEqual(response.headers["Location"], "/complaints")
        
        # Verify it was added
        response = client.get("/complaints")
        self.assertIn("Agent_999", response.text)
        self.assertIn("The human is being difficult.", response.text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
